blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court is looking into the killing of Basilan Regional Trial Court Presiding Judge Joseph Wee Sit and has vowed to support his family. The high court said in a statement that it is working closely with law enforcement agencies to investigate the killing of Judge Sit of the Basilan Regional Trial Court Branch 2 in Isabela City on Nov. 12. Sit was reportedly shot dead along Tumaga-Putik Road in Barangay Tumaga, Zamboanga City. Further details, however, cannot be disclosed to protect the safety of the individuals involved and prevent the investigation from being compromised. READ: Judiciary […]...
